reviews.text: Everyone is kind and considerate but above all the standard of pet care is truly excellent. As a client of long standing I could not be happier with the standard of service
Highly recommend Pets’n’ Vets!   Staff all very pleasant Everywhere very clean
Another great visit to Croofur .. vet is really good with my very nervous cat . Would recommend them to anyone.
A thoroughly professional and friendly practice in every way. Staff are always so pleasant, caring, reassuring and helpful! Our two Golden Retrievers love visiting!!
Great service from start to finish

The surgery is welcoming and friendly. I visited recently with 2 pets, my kitten for her first injection and my dog who is elderly and has serious health problems, both were treated with kindness and examined in a gentle and caring manner. I would not hesitate to recommend Pets’s N Vets Crookfur to anyone.

Whilst I would prefer the surgery opening 6 days a week, I understand that there may be staffing issues. Plus, you can always go to the state of the art hospital at The Roundhouse if necessary. Location wise, not far. I believe all major surgery is performed at the hospital.

Parking at both is easy.
Used this vets for years no problem whatsoever.
